Morocco’s king just pardoned nearly 1,700 criminals. The very next day, tens of thousands of Moroccans stormed Spain’s borders into Ceuta.  This isn’t random.  Muslims conquered Spain centuries ago and have never stopped viewing it as Islamic territory that must be reclaimed.  Al-Andalus was never fully forgotten. The Reconquista is still unfinished in their eyes.  Europe keeps pretending this is just “migration.” It’s not.

People are talking crazy during AFCON… saying Morocco isn’t African? 🤨 Let’s set the record straight: Morocco is part of Africa, and we show it. From Senegal, Ivory Coast, and Mali… to helping landlocked countries like Niger and Burkina Faso access the Atlantic… Morocco is building Africa, training leaders, and investing in the future. Proudly Moroccan. Proudly African. 💚 #africa#afcon#morocco#proud#fyp
